name: knowledge-os
description: Approval-gated conversational capture and task-relevant repository documentation for Knowledge OS durable Markdown records, with explicit one-time global and repository initialization when needed.

interface.longDescription: Detect durable decisions, reusable lessons, and recurring preferences in conversation, batch proposals at natural pauses, and capture only approved records in a configured Knowledge OS workspace. Initialize global host guidance or repository project bindings when explicitly requested, then retrieve and maintain task-relevant documentation without treating search results as verified.
capabilities: Initialize global Codex and Claude documentation guidance
Search, write notes, and propose decisions through the running Knowledge OS app
defaultPrompt: Capture durable decisions only after I approve them.
